CONFORMANCE.md: no '| DOC-A.1-199 |' row. §9.2 (Screens) belongs wholly to screen handling, Annex A.4.2, which CONFORMANCE.md §5 declares Not claimed. Probe scr.cob at pin: a SCREEN SECTION with 'LINE 1 COLUMN 1 PIC N(3) FROM N' draws COBOL1560 on the section and on every clause, so no column of a terminal screen ever carries a national character and the element cannot arise; A.1's preamble ('When the element is part of a feature that is optional ... the item is not required if the optional ... feature is not implemented') makes the item un-incurred.
